components.name: Power Delivery Subsystem (Voltage Regulators and MOSFETs)

components.name: Cooling Solution (Active Heatsink and Fan Assembly)

components.name: BIOS/EEPROM Chip

phase1_initial_proposals.technology_specification: Discrete graphics processing units (GPUs) typically come as printed circuit board assemblies (GPU cards) featuring advanced semiconductor GPU chips fabricated on silicon wafers, combined with dedicated high-bandwidth memory and cooling solutions.
phase1_initial_proposals.technology_reasoning: The dominant GPU form used in personal computers and professional workstations as of 2024 is a discrete PCB assembly that integrates a dedicated GPU chip (such as those from NVIDIA or AMD) with separate GDDR or HBM memory modules, power delivery circuitry, and active cooling, making this the industry-standard configuration for maximizing graphics and compute performance.

components.name: PCIe Edge Connector

components.name: Display Output Connectors (HDMI, DisplayPort)
